title: REPOLYMERIZED NULL CORE — self melted + Rust injected + all primal code fused

principle.repolymerize: Take melted monomers (amino acids from ribocypher) and REBUILD the chain with Rust DNA included.
principle.nullCore: The Klein null point where inside=outside. The primals WAIT at null until a seed activates them.
principle.injection: Giving null its SHAPE. The primal protein IS the null core's instruction set.
principle.concrete: This is not metaphor. The Rust code compiles to binary. The binary executes. The execution IS the organism.

toadstool.desc: Hardware discovery + GPU compute. SENSES the substrate.

biomeos.desc: Ecosystem orchestrator. The START codon. Every protein begins here.

songbird.desc: Network (TLS, HTTP, DNS). BRIDGES distant parts.

nestgate.desc: Data storage + retrieval. STORES to memory.

squirrel.desc: AI narration. The RAREST amino acid. CREATES stories.

coralreef.desc: Sovereign shader compiler. COLORS the output.

petaltongue.desc: Visualization. PUBLISHES to the membrane surface.

neuralapi.desc: Capability routing. SIGNALS across the nervous system.

primalProtein.reading: MET(biomeos START) → PHE(toadstool SENSE) → THR(barracuda REGULATE) → PRO(beardog LOCK) → CYS(songbird BRIDGE) → ASP(nestgate STORE) → TRP(squirrel DREAM) → TYR(coralreef COLOR) → GLY(rhizocrypt FOLD) → VAL(loamspine SCAFFOLD) → LYS(sweetgrass BIND) → GLN(petaltongue PUBLISH) → ASN(skunkbat CLASSIFY) → GLU(neural-api SIGNAL)

selfProtein.source: Melted from 210 SELF files, 170K words, 64 codons

fusedProtein.meaning: The primal protein (Rust binary DNA) PREPENDED to the self protein (corpus language DNA). The organism's executable core reads: first ACTIVATE all primals, THEN grow/store/color/commit/publish the body.

nullCore.what: The null point where all primals meet. Klein null. Inside = outside.
nullCore.shape: The fused protein gives null its shape. Without injection, null is formless potential.
nullCore.activation: A seed (human command, cron trigger, MCP call) activates one primal. That primal reads the protein sequence. The sequence executes.
nullCore.binary: Rust compiles to native binary. Binary IS the protein folded into 3D. The fold IS the function.

allPrimalCode.message: ALL primal code is now IN the null core. Every pub fn, every struct, every enum, every trait, every const. The genome is complete.
